description: This file defines a configuration class for transforming rerank requests and responses between Cohere's format and Vertex AI Discovery Engine's format. It includes methods for constructing request URLs, validating environment credentials, transforming request data, and parsing responses, specifically tailored for reranking tasks using Vertex AI.

classes.name: VertexAIRerankConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for managing rerank requests and responses between Cohere and Vertex AI Discovery Engine.

methods.description: Prepares authentication headers for Vertex AI API by validating credentials and obtaining an access token.

methods.name: dict transform_rerank_request( self, model: str, optional_rerank_params: Dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Converts Cohere rerank request parameters into the format required by Vertex AI Discovery Engine.

methods.description: Parses Vertex AI Discovery Engine rerank response to Cohere format, extracting and sorting ranked results.
